sections.title: General refund guidance
paragraphs: Refund requests for online payments are evaluated based on the timing of cancellation, service status, and transaction details.
Approved refunds are credited strictly back to the original payment source (bank account, UPI, credit/debit card) within standard banking timeframes.

sections.title: Eligible scenarios for refunds
items: Duplicate or accidental debit transactions for the same appointment booking
Advance payments made for services that could not be rendered due to clinic scheduling adjustments
Cancellations requested well in advance of the scheduled appointment slot

sections.title: Non-refundable scenarios
items: Consultations, diagnostics, or dental procedures that have already been fully or partially delivered
Administrative or specialized diagnostic fees consumed during patient examination
No-show appointments where the clinical team was kept waiting without prior notice

sections.title: Processing timeline
paragraphs: Once approved, refunds typically take 5 to 7 business days to reflect in your account, depending on your banking provider and payment gateway turnaround times.
Please share your Transaction ID and registered phone number when contacting us for refund inquiries.

sections.title: Appointment cancellation guidelines
